project: FOM fleet platform â€” scroll-driven cinematic intro
style: Photoreal cinematic aerial cinematography. ARRI Alexa 35, Zeiss Supreme Prime. Filmic dynamic range, subtle 35mm grain, atmospheric haze. Blue hour into night, no visible sun. Wet asphalt after light rain with soft specular reflections.
color: Base deep navy-teal #0A1626. Cool steel-blue surfaces #26415F. Warm sodium-amber streetlights as the only warm accent. Electric blue #208AEF in headlights and glass. Emerald #3DD68C accents. High contrast, crushed blacks, ACES filmic.
location: Cabimas / Maracaibo, Zulia, Venezuela â€” Costa Oriental del Lago. Low-rise tropical Latin American industrial port city: flat concrete rooftops with black water tanks, corrugated metal warehouses, palm trees, wide boulevards, oil storage tanks on the horizon, vast dark Lake Maracaibo, distant bridge lights.
mood: Calm precision. Surveillance-grade clarity. Competence and oversight, never menace, never dystopian.
subject: One clean white modern double-cab pickup truck. Identical in every shot. No badges, no plates.
hard_rules: Single continuous take per shot, no cuts
Constant camera speed, one direction only â€” footage is scrubbed forward and backward at variable speed
No text, numbers, logos or plates â€” all data is overlaid later in HTML
No lens flare pops, no strobing, no rolling shutter
Identical lighting and time of day across all shots
Chain image-to-video: last frame of each shot is the first frame of the next

shots.action: City grid reads as a live navigation map: dark blocks, thin glowing amber streets. Dark water fills the right third with an irregular coastline. Tiny vehicle lights crawl the arterials. Stillness.
Flat map blocks gain volume into real buildings with facades, rooftop tanks, cast shadows. Warehouse district and a wide divided boulevard resolve. Lake on the right horizon.
Industrial transport zone: fenced logistics yard, rows of parked trucks, fuel depot with cylindrical tanks, palms along the perimeter. Sodium light pools on wet asphalt.
Camera converges on a single white pickup alone on a wide wet boulevard. Traffic thins to nothing. Headlights throw two cold blue-white cones onto glossy asphalt.

shots.camera: Descend 25 to 1.5m, swing to the side, match vehicle speed
shots.action: Low three-quarter tracking. Truck locked motionless in frame while the city streaks past in motion blur. Streetlights sweep the white bodywork. Contact shadow and wet-road reflection. Background f/2.8 bokeh.

shots.camera: Drift backward and outward to full side profile
shots.action: Truck centered in the middle third with deliberate EMPTY negative space left and right â€” telemetry is overlaid there in HTML. Vehicle sharp, background quiet.

shots.camera: Pull back to 20m, above and behind, decelerate to near-still
shots.action: Wide three-quarter hero. Boulevard stretches into blue haze, dark lake at left, distant bridge as a thin line of lights. Symmetrical, calm, resolved.

negative: text, numbers, logos, license plates, watermarks, people, faces, cuts, jump cuts, lens flare, strobing, time-lapse, hyperlapse, fisheye, skyscrapers, European architecture, snow, daylight, drone propeller shadows
